scripts.backend:lint: node scripts/uv.mjs run --project backend --locked ruff check backend
scripts.backend:format:check: node scripts/uv.mjs run --project backend --locked ruff format --check backend
scripts.backend:test: node scripts/uv.mjs run --project backend --locked pytest -c backend/pyproject.toml
scripts.check:frontend: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
scripts.check:backend: npm run backend:lint && npm run backend:format:check && npm run backend:test
scripts.check: npm run check:frontend && npm run check:backend

backend/**/*.py: node scripts/uv.mjs run --project backend --locked ruff check --fix
node scripts/uv.mjs run --project backend --locked ruff format
